entries.05ca79c1d5f4bdd1: This business leases real estate it owns. It includes leasing buildings and land to subsidiaries.
entries.0d8aaecc081ff4ad: This business is carried on by Kimura Lease Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, which mainly rents building scaffolding. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥775 million.
entries.0f0fedea388c5b38: This business is carried on by Toyo Glass Kogyo Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, which installs sashes, glass, fittings and similar products. entries.0fb4ceb0f7bd132d: This business is operated by the consolidated subsidiary Joyful AK Co., Ltd., which runs home centers, pet specialty stores and building material specialty stores in Hokkaido and sells building materials, household goods, interior products, pet products, gardening supplies and other products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥24,135 million.
entries.1a42637c90ce7d9c: This business sells real estate such as condominiums. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company continued to recognize sales proceeds from the condominium "The Sapporo Towers."
entries.1b7364ff5e74ed5a: It wholesales residential equipment, exterior products, machine tools, temporary construction materials and others. It also handles original ventilation-related products.
entries.22f07e9d4da5b029: This is a wholesale business in which the company sells residential building materials and building materials for buildings, among other products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥9,547 million.
entries.29df6b72da14720e: It sells and installs fittings and similar products.
entries.36ce2185469f6e58: It operates five of the largest home centers in Hokkaido and sells building materials, household goods, interior products, gardening supplies and other products.
entries.4f2ee24cbc44fba1: It wholesales building sashes and other products.
entries.7b5d341dbcae62e6: It sells, processes and installs glass products such as aluminum sashes.
